name: OpenCode
what: An open-source AI coding agent with a terminal UI, plus a desktop app and IDE support. It works with API keys from many LLM providers. It has a full-access build agent and a read-only plan agent you switch between with Tab. MIT licensed.
who: Terminal users who want an open-source agent and the freedom to pick their own model provider.

setup.code:
curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/v2/install | bash
# or
npm install -g @opencode/cli

setup.text: OpenCode 1 (the install the GitHub README still shows):
setup.code:
curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash
# or
brew install anomalyco/tap/opencode

setup.text: Both versions use the opencode command and aren't installed side by side by default; the V2 installer replaces a V1 binary. If you're moving from V1, read opencode.ai/v2/docs/migrate-v1 first (V1 plugins don't run in V2).
cd into your project, run opencode, and add API keys for the providers you want to use.
